map.4xx 多为请求问题(路径/权限)，5xx 多为服务端 bug: 4xx is mostly a request problem (path or permissions), 5xx mostly a server-side bug
map.301/302 是重定向，307/308 更严格: 301 and 302 are redirects; 307 and 308 are stricter
map.404 资源未找到(可能临时)，410 明确表示已永久删除。: 404 means the resource was not found (possibly temporary), while 410 explicitly means it has been permanently removed.
map.输入 429 显示\"请求过多\"，提示限流需退避重试。: Entering 429 shows "Too Many Requests", indicating rate limiting and the need to back off and retry.
